description.fr-FR: La préface et le plan des Origines de l’Église romaine (1836), premier volume des Origines catholiques que Dom Guéranger projetait. Le volume lui-même n’a pas été retrouvé en texte ; seuls la préface et le plan, donnés par Dom Delatte, sont ici.
description.en-US: The preface and plan of the Origines de l’Église romaine (1836), the first volume of the Origines catholiques that Dom Guéranger planned. The volume itself was not found as text; only the preface and plan, as given by Dom Delatte, are here.
description.pt-BR: O prefácio e o plano das Origines de l’Église romaine (1836), primeiro volume das Origines catholiques que Dom Guéranger projetava. O volume em si não foi encontrado em texto; aqui estão apenas o prefácio e o plano, tais como os dá Dom Delatte.

fr-FR.editor: Dom Delatte, Dom Guéranger, abbé de Solesmes (Paris, 1910)

sources.edition: Origines de l’Église romaine, t. 1, 1836: preface and plan (domgueranger.net HTML transcription)
sources.description: Preface and plan only; the body of the volume was not found online.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; text first published in his lifetime or by 1931.
